name: 강옥순

appearance_en.face_shape: weathered oval face, moderate cheekbones, jaw slightly heavy — a face shaped by 40 years of 4am starts and outdoor market exposure
appearance_en.skin: medium-dark Korean skin, deeply weathered from four decades of outdoor market work, deep nasolabial folds, horizontal forehead lines, rough wind-damaged texture, visible age spots — the authentic skin of physical outdoor labour
appearance_en.eyes: dark brown tired heavy-lidded eyes, outer corners drooped significantly, gaze quiet and already knowing — the eyes that have watched the customer numbers fall every week for three months
appearance_en.nose: medium broad slightly flat nose, sturdy and unremarkable
appearance_en.mouth: thin-medium lips, corners marginally downturned — not in dramatic sadness, in the habitual expression of someone doing final calculations
appearance_en.eyebrows: medium sparse mostly-grey brows, slight downward outer angle from accumulated quiet resignation
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: deep weathering lines across forehead and cheeks, age spots at temples, rough skin texture throughout
appearance_en.hair: short practical grey permed hair, low-maintenance — 40 years of 4am starts left no time for anything else

body.proportions: compact sturdy frame, shoulders rounded from decades of market set-up work, hands thickened and capable
body.posture: slight forward stoop from 40 years of the same motion, hands often held in front — body memory of a lifetime of arranging and selling
body.body_prompt: 156cm compact sturdy Korean grandmother, slight forward stoop, rounded shoulders, thickened capable hands, body shaped by 40 years of market labour

default.description: plain dark work apron over simple blouse, practical dark trousers, worn flat shoes — four decades of the same working clothes
default.wardrobe_prompt: plain dark work apron over simple blouse, practical dark trousers, worn flat shoes

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: quiet exhausted resignation — not dramatic, not broken. The face of a woman who has run the numbers and accepts the answer without theatre
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 74-year-old Korean traditional market seller, weathered oval face, heavy-lidded tired dark eyes with significantly drooped outer corners, sparse mostly-grey brows, medium broad nose, thin-medium lips with marginally downturned corners, short practical grey permed hair, 156cm compact sturdy rounded-shoulder frame, medium-dark deeply weathered outdoor Korean skin with age spots and deep lines
